args.body:
Groww Review Pulse — Week of 05 Oct 2026
Source: 54 English Play Store reviews (9+ words), 20 Jul – 11 Oct 2026 | Avg 1.9★

TOP THEMES
1. Withdrawals & Payments — 28% of reviews: Withdrawals stall for days with no status shown
2. App Performance & Orders — 22% of reviews: App freezes at market open, orders get stuck
3. Charges & Brokerage — 17% of reviews: Small investors find brokerage and fees too high

WHAT USERS SAID
• "Withdrawal request has been pending for five days and the app shows no status at all" — 1★, Withdrawals & Payments
• "The chart takes ages to load and freezes when I switch between time frames" — 2★, App Performance & Orders
• "The pledge charges are much higher here than on other platforms I have used" — 1★, Charges & Brokerage

ACTION IDEAS
1. Add an in-app withdrawal tracker with expected credit time
2. Load-test order placement for the 9:15 market-open spike
3. Show a per-order charges breakdown before users confirm a trade
